market.summary: Brazil has mature national, state, municipal, university and technical-education library infrastructure, with uneven reader access and fragmented catalog integration. This bounded screen verifies10 substantial institutional targets, not the ten largest libraries nationally.
market.platform_strategy: Prioritize a Pergamum public-search/holdings adapter and two SophiA variants (modern fresh-form TerminalWeb; legacy ASP/PHP AJAX); reuse/test Koha for IFPE. Network-level deployments expand coverage without counting branches as separate institutions.

Physical copies, titles, mixed electronic/physical totals and network-size proxies are not interchangeable or summable. Historical dates retained.
Only bounded first-page title queries were used; three successes intentionally use related-title books, not exact editions of the searched novel.
Anonymous search is not a reuse licence, visitor-entry guarantee or borrowing entitlement. No authenticated access or live app test performed.

Raw evidence is bounded and anonymous form tokens/public client-config values are redacted; no cookies, credentials or browser state retained.
